year_policy: First public release year; development start and version 1.0 dates are distinct.
backend_policy: Describe the pinned compiler actually used by this study, including the code-generation backend separately from the system linker.

nim.name: Nim
nim.release_year_basis: Official Nim repository commit 916c25f is named first release and its committer timestamp is 2008-06-22T23:37:49Z.
nim.style: Compiled systems language with procedural, object-oriented, functional and metaprogramming forms; indentation-based syntax.

study_backend.label: AOT: Nim to C to Clang 22

study_memory.label: ORC: reference counting with cycle collection
study_memory.selection: Pinned --mm:orc; ordinary destructors and move semantics, with ORC cycle collection for potentially cyclic graphs.

nim.github_color_status: Assigned in GitHub Linguist Nim entry

crystal.name: Crystal
crystal.release_year_basis: The language team's 19 June 2014 announcement identifies 0.1.0 as the first official release, released the previous day.
crystal.style: General-purpose object-oriented language with Ruby-inspired syntax, compiled static type checking and fibers/channels.

study_backend.label: AOT: Crystal / LLVM 15.0.7
study_backend.language_backend: LLVM 15.0.7, confirmed by the retained macOS compiler --version output
study_backend.native_linker: Explicit Clang 22 selected by CC; this does not change the Crystal LLVM code generator
study_backend.native_target: macOS ARM64; explicit SDK and deployment target 14.4

study_memory.label: Boehm conservative garbage collection
study_memory.selection: The unchanged official package supplies Boehm GC; ordinary default collection remains enabled, with no GC-disable compiler/runtime option.

crystal.github_color_status: Assigned in GitHub Linguist Crystal entry

pony.name: Pony
pony.release_year_basis: The designer's official history says the compiler/runtime were open sourced in May 2015; official tag 0.1.0 refers to commit 4d7087e dated 28 April 2015. Both establish the same public-release year.
pony.style: Object-oriented actor language with asynchronous behaviours and capability-based data sharing.

study_backend.label: AOT: ponyc / LLVM 23.1.2
study_backend.language_backend: LLVM 23.1.2, confirmed by the retained official compiler --version output
study_backend.compiler_build_toolchain: AppleClang 21.0.0.21000101 ARM64, reported by ponyc; distinct from application LLVM code generation
study_backend.native_target: aarch64-apple-macosx14.4.0; explicit SDK and library paths

study_memory.label: ORCA actor garbage collection with reference capabilities
study_memory.selection: The ordinary Pony runtime's per-actor object/actor collection and capability rules remain enabled; no disabled-GC timing mode is selected.

pony.github_color_status: GitHub Linguist Pony entry has no color field at the verified commit; no GitHub color is invented.
